Query.Sql: select patient_identifier_value, EVENT_END_DT_TM, EVENT, RESULT_VALUE, RESULT_UNITS, NORMAL_LOW, NORMAL_HIGH, md5(to_json(row(WAREHOUSE_IDENTIFIER, EVENT_END_DT_TM, EVENT, RESULT_VALUE, RESULT_UNITS, NORMAL_LOW, NORMAL_HIGH))) as record_connection_identifier from ##duckdb_source## where trim(EVENT) in ('Apical Heart Rate', 'Heart Rate', 'Heart Rate Monitored', 'Peripheral Pulse Rate') and isfinite(try_cast(trim(RESULT_VALUE) as double)) and (RESULT_UNITS is null or lower(trim(RESULT_UNITS)) in ('', '<no data>', 'bpm')) order by all

Explanation.Description: Heart or pulse rate event; original method is retained in the source value. Time-point and (M) events are excluded.
Finite numeric heart rate, preserved without physiological clipping.
Original supplied units. Missing units are interpreted as bpm; other explicit units are excluded.
Stable hash of the warehouse identifier and original event timestamp, name, result, units and ranges; preserves distinct same-day readings and identifies identical rows on reruns.
